Trevor Adair · The person behind the camera

The person behind the photographs

A love for people.
An eye for the light.

I’m Trevor, a photographer based in Utah County. My work moves between portraits, families, couples, and the natural world—always with an eye for the details that make a photograph feel alive.

From a quiet trail to a room full of celebration, I want to make images you recognize yourself in.

A thoughtful, easy experience

Good photographs start
with feeling comfortable.

The experience ↗
01 /

Start with your story.

Tell me who you’re celebrating, what you have in mind, and when. We’ll work out the kind of session that fits.

02 /

Make room to be you.

We’ll choose a setting and plan the details. During your session, I’ll give you direction and leave room for the moments between poses.

03 /

Keep this chapter close.

Your photographs will be thoughtfully edited into a gallery you can revisit, share, and make part of your everyday life.
